subject: Thanks
text:
Hi team,
I want to thank our teammate today. You helped finish the delivery. I know we disagreed. You wanted a looser edit. I asked for tighter captions. That was a bit tense. Still, you listened well. You did not push me away. We found a middle path. I appreciate that. Your notes were sharp. They caught errors I missed. They saved us a late night. I am grateful. I will remember this. I hope the next job is easier. It may not be. That is fine. We handled it well. Thanks again. The client liked the tone. They called it clean. That was partly your work. I do not take that lightly. Team effort matters. Even when we argue. Especially then. Your patience helped. I learned from it. We should work like this again soon, too.
